recipes.name: Easy Pleasy Mac N Cheesy - US Navy Style
ingredients_raw: 8 ounces processed cheese (such as Velveeta®), cubed
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease an 8x8-inch baking dish.

Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the macaroni, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Transfer the macaroni to a large bowl, and stir in the processed cheese cubes, Cheddar cheese soup, sour cream, Parmesan cheese, milk, salt, and black pepper. Pour into the prepared baking dish. Mix the cracker crumbs with the butter, and sprinkle over the casserole. Cover the casserole with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling, about 30 minutes; remove foil and bake until crumbs are golden brown, 5 to 10 more minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Pleasy Mac N Cheesy - US Navy Style
raw_recipe.description: This recipe hearkens back to the thick, mild, creamy macaroni and cheese served on board the Navy ship USS Enterprise.

review.reviewBody: I made this for dinner tonight and we thought it to be the best mac and cheese we have ever had. It was very moist and flavorful. I found it to be a recipe that will serve more than 6. The two of us will be eating it for several days! Thank you for sharing this recipe. My husband is AF retired but the Navy serves really good food! Thank you also for serving in the armed forces. You are special people.

**Updated** 
I'm only giving this 3 right now because I know why it didn't come out the way is suppose to. 
My boyfriend and I didn't notice how small the serving sizes were. We bought everything we needed but when we got home decided to double the batch. There was enough of everything except the condensed cheddar cheese soup. 
Because of that, I believe that is why it didn't come out as creamy as it was meant to be. 
We're going to redo this recipe in the near future and I will update my rating and review off of that outcome of that batch.
*Made this recipe again this weekend for a BBQ. Turned out really good! Instead of mixing everything on the stove top and baking I mixed everything into a crockpot and once melted added the cooked pasta. Let that sit in there for a couple of hours on high heat to let it thicken a little. It was very good! Everyone loved it. I had a lot let over since I doubled it and had extra to take home. My DnD group later ate the rest of it lol.

Made this for 75 people for a dinner we were catering. Everyone LOVED it. Very easy to come together. I did mix all the sauce ingredients together in a big pot while the pasta was cooking & then added the drained pasta to the pot. The cheese melted without curdling. I did replace some of the Velveeta with shredded CoJack & used Ritz crackers for the topping. Other than those minor changes I made it as directed. So rich & cheesy.

Like many others I cut back on the sour cream (2/3 cup light sour cream rather than 1 cup), used 4 oz Velveeta and 4 oz cheddar/edam cheese), and used closer to 10 oz noodles than 8. I didn't have saltines so I used plain breadcrumbs for the topping. I poured into 2 separate pans. One for us for dinner, and the other for a friend, and everyone raved about it :) Great recipe!!

I used lite sour cream and added T of cayenne and a T of garlic powder. I also added a 1/2 cup of shredded sharp cheddar cheese. It is the best macaroni and cheese I've ever had! I made it in the crock pot rather that the oven. Suoer moist!

The tanginess imparted by sour cream serves to underscore the cheese flavor, but we felt that one full cup was overkill. We don't want to taste the sour cream - we're all about the CHEESE! The reduction to 1/2 cup as others have noted, is just about right, replacing the remaining 1/2 cup with milk. As I didn't serve it immediately, the sauce tightened up considerably during the wait, so I blended in even more milk. I didn't measure how much, but if I had to guess, I'd say it was about an additional 1/4-1/3 cup. Just make it slightly looser than you think you need, because the starch in the pasta absorbs liquid readily. Sautéed some boneless chicken breasts, cut into small cubes, in garlic butter with fresh thyme and folded in to make it a complete meal. A hit all around!

I love this recipe. It is my go to potluck dish and I’m always asked for the recipe. I have made it exactly as directed and it’s delicious but I typically double the recipe and make the following adjustments; add 1lb of bacon cooked and crumbled, substitute Panko bread crumbs for the cracker topping.

Holy phenomenal!!! This is easily the best Mac and Cheese I have ever had. Two things I did differently. Since the noodles and Velveeta came in 16 oz., I just doubled the batch. I also used heavy cream instead of milk. It was a hit...

I don't know if it was the quality of the processed cheese that I used (store brand vs name brand) or that I substituted cream of mushroom soup (and it was 98% fat free), but the taste was very bland, and I didn't like that the cheese was in globs in the dish. I didn't use the cracker topping, so after the 30 minutes I stirred it up to incorporate the cheese into the sauce and put it back into the oven for a few minutes. The taste was just lacking something. I put a bag of shredded sharp cheddar (8 oz) into it and mixed it all up again and baked it another 10 minutes. The sauce prior to the cheddar was on the loose side and after was very rich. I think I may have used a little too much. Next time I'm going to use the cheddar soup and a little bit of dry mustard (before adding any cheddar) and see if that makes a difference.

My family said, make this Mac and cheese recipe for now on. Everyone loved the creaminess. Melted all cheese together and added smoked paprika and garlic powder for extra flavor before mixing in macaroni. Also used ritz crackers. Loved it!!

My family said, make this Mac and cheese recipe for now on. Everyone loved the creaminess. Melted all cheese together and added smoked paprika and garlic powder for extra flavor before mixing in macaroni. Also used ritz crackers. Loved it!!

Hi, this is easy and good!! Just some suggestions..I have some in my family that are gluten intolerant...so I used no gluten elbow or rotini..made with Quinoa flour...and yea...I do not like velveeta so used cheddar...and you can add some spices to give it a little zip...a dash of ceyanne or a few red pepper flake...I have not done this yet, but for topping ... will try to use a bit of crushed and spicy pork rinds, also gluten free.. Great recipe!!!
I always add garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and real cheddar cheese to this, but it’s such a hit I’m asked to make it at every family meal!!!

I made this as the recipe directed. The submitter claimed it was mild and it was. It was too mild, it was pretty bland the first night. The next day it was a little better but still needed more seasoning. I can't comment on how closely this dish resembles what the US Navy serves since I have no experience with that. But if I make this recipe again, I will omit the cheddar cheese soup (which I've never cared for because it doesn't have much of a cheese taste) and use more actual cheese and maybe a basic white sauce in its place. I will certainly add more seasoning, including ground white pepper in place of the black pepper and maybe more salt.

Love it! Perfect creamy comfort food. Hubby doesn't like mac and cheese but he loves this! Passes the 4-year-old taste challenge even with the "white stuff". First dish she's ever helped make... twice now!
Outstanding!
We love this Mac and Cheese!

I didn't make any changes except using shredded Cheddar cheese instead of Velveeta and spiral rotini instead of macaroni shaped pasta, and I really loved the taste of this dish. It's definitely packed with calories, but if you are looking for a great recipe for a delicious mac n cheese comfort food meal, this is it! We ate all of it the first day, and it's just two of us.
Everyone loved it.
This was the mac and cheese I've been looking for! Thick and moist. Made it a the recipe was written, and it was very good, but I think I will try adding a few extras for a little more flavor.
